sections.overview: Lepilemur milanoii, the Daraina sportive lemur, is a primate endemic to northern Madagascar.
sections.identification: It was described as a distinct species in 2006 using molecular and morphological evidence.
sections.habitat: It occurs in dry deciduous, gallery and semi-evergreen forests of the Loky–Manambato region and nearby northern forest blocks.
sections.diet: The species-specific diet was not detailed in the field and assessment sources consulted.
sections.behavior: A northern Madagascar field study treats it among endangered nocturnal lemurs surveyed in forest fragments.
sections.reproduction: The sources consulted do not provide species-specific breeding details.
sections.ecology: It has been reported alongside another sportive lemur Lepilemur ankaranensis in the Andrafiamena area; that species has no profile in this batch.
sections.conservation: The IUCN assessment published in 2020 classified it as Endangered, citing a restricted, fragmented forest range and continuing habitat decline.
